name: Feiyang Zhu
tagline: Grounded in math. Research, mentorship, and delivery.
introduction: I'm a Mathematics and Applied Mathematics undergraduate working across quantitative finance, financial AI, product design, and software engineering. I lead research teams, mentor contributors, and help interdisciplinary projects move from a question to a reproducible result or a working product.
academic_context: I assist an economics and management faculty team at Tsinghua University's Shenzhen International Graduate School, focusing on computing-related product research. I'm also a Tsinghua x-lab member and president of my university's Mathematical Modeling Association.
experience: Previously: Quantitative Research Intern at Two Sigma (Hong Kong, 2025–2026); HR Intern at Alibaba International (Shenzhen, 2024).
research_approach: I shape research questions, design methods, plan tasks, guide contributors, review experiments and implementations, and integrate the team's results.

research_projects.name: Credit Risk & Explainable ML
research_projects.focus: WOE/IV scorecards, LightGBM, SHAP, and reproducible model comparison.

research_projects.name: A-share Multi-factor Research
research_projects.focus: Point-in-time alignment, factor construction, neutralization, IC analysis, and backtesting.

research_projects.name: Financial Research Assistant
research_projects.focus: Financial-document RAG, hybrid retrieval, cited answers, extraction, and quality/latency/cost evaluation.

research_projects.name: Regime-aware Factor Allocation
research_projects.focus: Market-state indicators, dynamic weighting, rolling out-of-sample tests, and robustness checks.

research_projects.name: ML Stock Selection & Explainable Alpha
research_projects.focus: Ridge and LightGBM, stock ranking, cost-aware backtesting, SHAP, and feature ablation.

research_principles: I care about point-in-time data, preventing leakage, out-of-sample evaluation, interpretability, and reproducibility—and helping teammates understand the methods behind their work.
